profile.name: Dilukshika Sivanathan
profile.headline: Junior Software & Data Developer
profile.tagline: I build data-collection and monitoring systems — from sensor to dashboard.
profile.availability: Seeking a Skilled Worker sponsored junior software developer or data role in the UK
summary: First-Class Honours graduate in Applied Computing (University of South Wales) with a Distinction-level Higher National Diploma in Software Engineering, covering programming, application development and database design.

Backed by nearly three years of hands-on IT experience at the University of Jaffna supporting Linux/Windows systems, servers and networks, plus practical project work building IoT data-collection and monitoring systems with real-time dashboards and automated logging.

Over a year of UK work history, a quick learner who communicates clearly with stakeholders at all levels and adapts fast to new tools. Recently co-authored peer-reviewed research on AI-driven cybersecurity education, presented at an international conference.

projects.title: Energy Meter with Data Collection & Monitoring System
projects.summary: A real-time energy monitoring system measuring voltage, current and power, streaming live readings to a cloud dashboard with automated data logging.
highlights: Built on an ESP8266 microcontroller with SCT-013 (current) and ZMPT101B (voltage) sensors
Streamed live readings to a Blynk IoT dashboard for real-time visualisation
Automated logging to Google Sheets via webhook integration for ongoing analysis and reporting
Demonstrated a complete end-to-end pipeline: acquisition → processing → visualisation → logging

projects.title: CyberSafe — AI-Driven Cybercrime Vulnerability Assessment
projects.summary: An AI framework using ensemble machine learning for predictive cybercrime vulnerability assessment among Sri Lankan school students, with explainable AI and adaptive game-based learning.
highlights: Ensemble machine learning (SVM and Random Forest) achieving 93%+ predictive accuracy
SHAP-based explainability for transparent, auditable risk scoring
18 adaptive game-based learning modules driven by assessed vulnerability
Delivered as a MERN-stack web application with a Flask AI microservice

projects.title: Smart Document Locker System
projects.summary: A secure physical document locker using multi-factor authentication, combining hardware integration with embedded programming.
highlights: Multi-factor authentication via RFID and biometric verification
Built on Arduino with integrated hardware and embedded programming
Applied security, access-control and application development principles
Delivered from concept through to a working prototype
